comment: The XBE each generated variant is lifted from, checked by regenerate.py and find_pointer_targets.py before they read it. Seeds and title bindings hold addresses of this exact build, so another build would generate code that does not match them (docs/analysis/exceed-xbe-overview.md). An md5 of null means the build is not registered yet: scripts/recomp/register_xbe.py fills it from the user's default.xbe.
